questions.question: Define the principal focus of a concave mirror.
answer_steps: Rays of light parallel to the principal axis of a concave mirror, after reflection, all meet at a point on the principal axis.
This point is the principal focus (F) of the concave mirror.

answer_steps_hi: अवतल दर्पण के मुख्य अक्ष के समांतर प्रकाश किरणें परावर्तन के बाद मुख्य अक्ष के एक बिंदु पर मिलती हैं।
यह बिंदु अवतल दर्पण का मुख्य फ़ोकस (F) है।

questions.question: Name a mirror that can give an erect and enlarged image of an object.
answer_steps: A concave mirror.
It gives an erect, enlarged (virtual) image when the object is placed between its pole and principal focus.
questions.question_hi: उस दर्पण का नाम बताइए जो बिंब का सीधा तथा आवर्धित प्रतिबिंब बना सके।
questions.question_gu: એવા અરીસાનું નામ આપો જે વસ્તુનું સીધું અને મોટું પ્રતિબિંબ આપી શકે.

questions.question: Why do we prefer a convex mirror as a rear-view mirror in vehicles?
answer_steps: A convex mirror always gives an erect, though diminished, image.
It also has a much wider field of view because it curves outwards, so the driver can see a large area behind.

questions.question: A concave mirror produces three times magnified (enlarged) real image of an object placed at 10 cm in front of it. Where is the image located?
answer_steps: Real image, so $m = -3$; $u = -10$ cm.
$m = -\dfrac{v}{u}$ gives $v = -mu = -(-3)(-10) = -30$ cm. The image is 30 cm in front of the mirror.
questions.question_hi: कोई अवतल दर्पण अपने सामने 10 cm दूरी पर रखे किसी बिंब का तीन गुणा आवर्धित (बड़ा) वास्तविक प्रतिबिंब बनाता है। प्रतिबिंब दर्पण से कितनी दूरी पर है?
questions.question_gu: કોઈ અંતર્ગોળ અરીસો પોતાની સામે 10 cm અંતરે મૂકેલી વસ્તુનું ત્રણ ગણું મોટું વાસ્તવિક પ્રતિબિંબ બનાવે છે. પ્રતિબિંબ અરીસાથી કેટલા અંતરે છે?
answer_steps_hi: वास्तविक प्रतिबिंब, अतः $m = -3$; $u = -10$ cm।
$m = -\dfrac{v}{u}$ से $v = -mu = -(-3)(-10) = -30$ cm। प्रतिबिंब दर्पण के सामने 30 cm पर है।
answer_steps_gu: વાસ્તવિક પ્રતિબિંબ, તેથી $m = -3$; $u = -10$ cm.
$m = -\dfrac{v}{u}$ પરથી $v = -mu = -(-3)(-10) = -30$ cm. પ્રતિબિંબ અરીસાની સામે 30 cm અંતરે છે.

questions.question: A ray of light travelling in air enters obliquely into water. Does the light ray bend towards the normal or away from the normal? Why?
answer_steps: Towards the normal.
Water is optically denser than air, so light slows down on entering it and bends towards the normal.

questions.question: The refractive index of diamond is 2.42. What is the meaning of this statement?
answer_steps: The ratio of the speed of light in vacuum (air) to the speed of light in diamond is 2.42.
So light travels 2.42 times slower in diamond than in vacuum: about $1.24 \times 10^{8}$ m/s.
questions.question_hi: हीरे का अपवर्तनांक 2.42 है। इस कथन का क्या अभिप्राय है?

answer_steps_hi: निर्वात (वायु) में प्रकाश की चाल और हीरे में प्रकाश की चाल का अनुपात 2.42 है।
अतः हीरे में प्रकाश निर्वात से 2.42 गुना धीमा चलता है: लगभग $1.24 \times 10^{8}$ m/s।
answer_steps_gu: શૂન્યાવકાશ (હવા) માં પ્રકાશની ઝડપ અને હીરામાં પ્રકાશની ઝડપનો ગુણોત્તર 2.42 છે.
તેથી હીરામાં પ્રકાશ શૂન્યાવકાશ કરતાં 2.42 ગણો ધીમો જાય છે: આશરે $1.24 \times 10^{8}$ m/s.
